commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "f4afaff647ad5ceaf55d21e8f17a2ee06042b2c7"

npm ci
npm install --save-dev vitest@^5.0.1 @vitejs/plugin-react@^4.7.0 typescript@^5.9.3 vite@^6.4.3
npm update
npm audit fix
cd ..
git diff --check
changed=$(git diff --name-only | sort)
test "$changed" = $'frontend/package-lock.json\nfrontend/package.json'
git diff -- frontend/package.json frontend/package-lock.json
